page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr9i.6xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance configured on the KVM hypervisor. It features 24 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor running at a clock speed of 3.4 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is equipped with 192.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by an 18 Gbps baseline bandwidth. The absence of local storage and GPUs makes this instance highly specialized for memory-intensive workloads that rely on network-attached storage.

Given its high memory density of 8.0 GB per core and dedicated CPU allocation, the ecs.hfr9i.6xlarge is designed for memory-intensive applications. It is suitable for workloads such as in-memory databases, large-scale caching layers, enterprise resource planning systems, and memory-bound data processing tasks that do not require local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration.
